subject: FinLytics - Evening cohort runbook, waitlist & standby coverage
messages:
From: Sarah Park <sarah.park@finlytics.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Cc: onboarding@finlytics.com
Date: 2026-08-16T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Evening cohort — availability and waitlist question

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We have a handful of engineers who can only join after 6pm PT and we'd like to sign up for the compact console + API enablement cohort you mentioned. A couple of quick questions before we lock in dates:

- Do you run the compact runbook (console walkthrough + API deep-dive) as a single 2.5 hour evening session or split across two evenings?
- If the evening cohort fills up, do you maintain a waitlist and standby coverage in case someone drops? We have people on different shifts and will probably swap seats last minute.
- We have a billing admin who may need to be looped in for procurement questions — will adding them later cause any issues?

Appreciate any details and sample runbook/ops roster. If it helps, we can open a short call to align calendars.

Best,
Sarah Park
Director, Cloud Engineering | FinLytics
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Park <sarah.park@finlytics.com>
Cc: camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com, rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-08-16T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evening cohort — availability and waitlist question

Hi Sarah — great to hear and glad the demo was useful. Short answers up front: we can run the compact format as either a single 2.5h evening session or two 90-minute evenings (we recommend single sessions for momentum unless your team needs multiple nights). We do keep a waitlist and an ops standby roster to cover last-minute swaps.

Proposed next steps:
1) Decide single-night vs split. We have an evening single-night slot on Tue 2026-09-07 18:00-20:30 PT (recommended) and a split option Thu/Fri 2026-09-09 & 2026-09-10 18:00-19:30 PT.
2) If you expect more than 1–2 last-minute swaps, we can provision a standby coach and mark up to 3 waitlist seats; standby coverage is billed at a nominal flat fee (I attached the runbook and the ops roster template).
3) Add your billing contact now or when you’re ready — Rafael (cc'd) can pick up procurement questions and provide the DocuSign link if needed.

Attachments: runbook_preflight_checklist.pdf (compact format), ops_roster.csv (standby template)
Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/98765

Camila (Enablement) — can you confirm coach availability for the Tue single-night slot and whether we can staff a standby coach if FinLytics wants the 3-seat waitlist?

Sarah — happy to jump on a 15m call this afternoon if you prefer.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Sarah Park <sarah.park@finlytics.com>
Date: 2026-08-17T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evening cohort — availability and waitlist question

Marissa / Sarah — thanks for looping me in.

We can staff the Tue 2026-09-07 18:00-20:30 PT single-night compact session. Standby coverage: yes, we can allocate one coach as an on-call standby for up to three waitlist swaps. That coach would join muted and only unmute if a session hit capacity or an attendee lost access. Operational notes:

- Standby coach coverage requires the ops_roster.csv completed with preferred contact numbers and timezone offsets at least 72 hours before the session.
- We'll need API sandbox keys for 2 developers in advance (48h lead time) to pre-provision test accounts; Sarah, can you confirm who should receive those?

Quick logistics: I'll update the ops_roster.csv (attached) with a suggested on-call rotation; Marissa, Rafael — do you want me to include cost line-items for standby coverage and a one-time seat swap buffer?

Thanks all — looking forward to it.

Best,
